issues.evidence: Built without SITE_INDEXABLE, served with SITE_INDEXABLE=true: robots.txt still returns 'User-Agent: * / Disallow: /' and every page ships <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"/>. app/robots.ts output is prerendered at build time and `indexable` in app/layout.tsx is a build-time const — neither reacts to runtime env.
issues.why: If the Vercel production build environment lacks SITE_INDEXABLE=true at BUILD time, launch ships completely invisible to every crawler and AI bot.
issues.fix: Make robots.txt request-time (export const dynamic='force-dynamic' in app/robots.ts) or assert SITE_INDEXABLE==='true' in the production build step; post-launch, curl /robots.txt and any page's meta robots on the real domain.

issues.evidence: Exactly 1 markdown body link exists across all content (plan-your-visit.md -> coming-from-outside-nagpur). 'Explore' sections in diabetes.md:58, heart-care.md:49, obesity.md:46 render as unlinked plain text ('Type 2 diabetes · Type 1 diabetes · ...'). Supports never link back to their pillar inside body copy.
issues.why: Pillar-cluster authority depends on contextual links; nav/footer/widget links carry far less topical weight.
issues.fix: Convert 'Explore' lists to real links; each support links to its pillar in the first third of copy; add cross-sibling prose links; link relevant blog posts from service pages.

issues.evidence: hubSubServices() filters /vaccination/ out of the Blooming Buds hub carousel (l.href !== '/vaccination/'), so the hub page links to it nowhere — not even as a widget.
issues.why: A service page with no link from its own hub looks less important to crawlers.
issues.fix: Include vaccination in the Blooming Buds hub service list, or document the reason for exclusion.

issues.affected: both doctor pages + every emitted Physician node
issues.evidence: '<!-- PENDING: restore when supplied — Registration: Maharashtra Medical Council Reg. No. [CONFIRM] -->' on both doctor pages; Physician nodes have no identifier property.
issues.why: Medical council registration is a core YMYL trust signal.
issues.fix: Add MMC registration number + council name to both profiles and Physician schema identifier once supplied.

issues.evidence: Rendered HTML on /diabetes/ shows 'Last reviewed: ' — blank. Templates never pass lastReviewed and the fallback returns null in production. Schema lastReviewed (git date) is emitted while the visible date is blank — schema/visible-content mismatch.
issues.why: A visibly blank 'Last reviewed:' looks broken and contradicts the structured-data claim.
issues.fix: Pass page.modified (formatted) into ReviewerBox so visible date matches schema; or omit the line when no date exists.

issues.evidence: LegalTemplate renders 'Last updated: {lastUpdated ?? <Confirm>date</Confirm>}' but the caller never passes lastUpdated; site.legalLastUpdated ('21 August 2026') exists but is unused. Raw HTML shows 'Last updated:' empty.
issues.why: Same blank-date defect on every trust page.
issues.fix: Pass site.legalLastUpdated (or a per-page value) into LegalTemplate.

issues.evidence: Zero external links in all content files. Named claims like 'ICMR-INDIAB study ... 101 million Indians in 2021' (diabetes.md) and IAP vaccine schedule references have no linked source. No Sources section exists.
issues.why: Uncited claims are weak under YMYL review and give AI engines nothing to cite.
issues.fix: Add a short Sources section (2-5 authoritative links: ICMR-INDIAB Lancet paper, IAP schedule, ADA/WHO/NICE) on key medical pages; link stats inline where natural.

issues.affected: /doctors/dr-prajakta-kaduskar/ and every page emitting her node
issues.evidence: physicianExtras.prajakta sets only medicalSpecialty — her visible credentials (MBBS, DCH, PGDAP, MA Clinical Psychology) are absent from schema while Ajay's are fully modelled (hasCredential, alumniOf, memberOf). Neither Physician has sameAs (GBP empty) or identifier.
issues.why: Asymmetric entity data weakens the knowledge-graph signal for half the site's authorship.
issues.fix: Add hasCredential/alumniOf/memberOf for Prajakta; add identifier + sameAs when client supplies reg numbers and GBP/profile URLs.

issues.evidence: image-map.ts labels hero/consult/corridor/desk/tablet portraits 'AI portraits (approved, marketing contract 2 Oct 2026)'. These serve as doctor hero images and Physician schema image.
issues.why: Synthetic provider photos on a YMYL site are an authenticity risk even when client-approved.
issues.fix: Keep the documented sign-off; prefer real photos for avatar and schema image; confine AI portraits to decorative use.

issues.affected: 0 FAQs: workshops, ecg, tmt-stress-test, body-composition, lab, home-sample-collection, pharmacy, blooming-buds hub, coming-from-outside-nagpur. <4 FAQs: well-baby, psychological-testing, heart-care, 2d-echo, care-programme, preventive, complications-screening, nutrition, prediabetes, diabetes-myths post
issues.evidence: content-metrics.csv faq counts; rendered FAQPage Question counts match exactly.
issues.why: FAQ sections are the highest-yield AEO surface; key service pages have none.
issues.fix: Add 4-6 real-question FAQs per service page, rendered via the existing FaqAccordion pipeline so visible text and schema stay identical.

issues.evidence: Zero INR/fee/price mentions across all 48 content files.
issues.why: 'How much does X cost in Nagpur' is the top commercial question; the site answers it nowhere.
issues.fix: Add honest fee guidance (consultation fee, test costs or 'call for current fees') once the client confirms prices; add cost FAQs.

issues.evidence: Sitemap contains 'https://www.niramayclinics.com' (no trailing slash) — produced by 404.md url:"" ; the filter only excludes '-'.
issues.why: Non-canonical, non-trailing-slash URL in the sitemap contradicts canonical policy.
issues.fix: Filter out empty/'-' urls in sitemap().

issues.affected: ~85 legacy URLs when requested without trailing slash
issues.evidence: curl: /videos ->308-> /videos/ ->307-> / ; /offer/45 ->308-> /offer/45/ ->308-> /services/ ; /contact/thank-you ->308-> /contact/thank-you/ ->307-> /thank-you/. Two hops for every slash-less legacy hit; /videos and /contact/thank-you are permanent:false (307).
issues.why: Chains waste crawl budget; temporary codes on retired pages don't pass equity.
issues.fix: Match both slash forms directly in redirect sources; make /videos and /contact/thank-you permanent:true.

issues.evidence: meta_description empty in frontmatter; rendered pages carry no description tag (crawl dlen=0).
issues.why: Google composes its own snippet for 6 indexable trust pages.
issues.fix: Write 140-160 char descriptions per page.

issues.affected: diabetes/, obesity/, thyroid-clinic/, hypertension-clinic/, complications-screening/, adolescent-health/, diabetes-care-programme/, prediabetes-risk-assessment/, lab pages
issues.evidence: No 'when to see a doctor' / safety-netting block on these pages (content-metrics seedoc=0).
issues.why: Safety-netting is expected on YMYL condition pages by quality raters.
issues.fix: Add a short 'See a doctor soon if...' block per condition page.

issues.evidence: Body word counts: /blooming-buds/ 290, /heart-care/ 378, /obesity/ 494, /diabetes/ 705 — far below the 2,500-4,000 pillar model (this is a service site, so the model applies loosely, but hubs are still thin).
issues.why: Thin hubs under-claim topical authority.
issues.fix: Expand hubs: 2-3 lines + link per support service, overview of approach, common questions, cost note.

issues.evidence: Service pages show 'Written by the Niramay Clinics medical content team' (no named author) and the box renders only at page bottom; nothing above the fold shows reviewer or dates.
issues.why: Anonymous 'content team' + no above-fold review signal is weaker YMYL authorship.
issues.fix: Add a compact 'Medically reviewed by Dr. X · Last reviewed <date>' line under each H1.

issues.evidence: These pages' graphs contain only clinic+website+breadcrumb — no WebPage/AboutPage/ContactPage/CollectionPage node even though frontmatter 'schema' names them. Fallback types every non-condition MedicalWebPage 'about' as MedicalProcedure (e.g. 'Home sample collection' as a procedure).
issues.why: Page-type nodes help engines classify trust pages; mis-typing 'Plan your visit' as a procedure is wrong.
issues.fix: Emit the declared page type per frontmatter (AboutPage, ContactPage, CollectionPage, ItemList, FAQPage as webpage type); restrict MedicalProcedure to real procedures.

issues.evidence: /vaccination/ never names BCG/MMR/HPV/typhoid or schedule ages (71% coverage); /obesity/ lacks bariatric-surgery and adolescent-obesity mentions (76%); /diabetes/ hub doesn't name neuropathy/CGM.
issues.why: Missing named entities cap topical-authority coverage.
issues.fix: Add entity-bearing sentences using facts the clinic already claims (IAP schedule -> name vaccines; weight management -> mention surgery-referral boundary).

issues.evidence: Hero Image alt={h1} — e.g. alt='Diabetes and metabolic care in Nagpur' on a photo of Dr. Ajay. alt-text.json contains proper descriptive alts that the overrides don't use.
issues.why: Alt text describes the page, not the photo — fails item 19.
issues.fix: Resolve hero alts through alt-text.json or add alt strings to heroImageOverrides.

issues.evidence: openGraph.type:'article' emitted on every page including home, services, doctors, legal.
issues.why: Wrong og:type on non-article pages.
issues.fix: og:type 'website' on home/indexes, 'profile' on doctor pages.

issues.evidence: Not in any header or footer nav column; inbound only from home ServiceTabs + 404 page.
issues.why: Sitemap-listed index page with near-orphan inbound profile.
issues.fix: Add /services/ to a nav/footer column, or drop from sitemap if intentionally minor.

issues.evidence: Working files served publicly at /images/_todo.md and /images/alt-text.json.
issues.why: Internal notes exposed (no secrets, but untidy).
issues.fix: Move both out of public/.

issues.evidence: Rendered titles are 61 chars ('Editorial and Medical Review Policy | Niramay Clinics, Nagpur', 'Patient rights and responsibilities | Niramay Clinics, Nagpur').
issues.why: Just over the ~60-char SERP budget.
issues.fix: Set seo_title overrides.

issues.evidence: Raw HTML has zero <form>/<input>/<label> — useSearchParams forces the client form outside the prerender. The code comment claims a native POST works without JS, but no form exists in no-JS HTML.
issues.why: No-JS users and agent crawlers see no booking mechanism (phone/WhatsApp links do cover them).
issues.fix: Render a static form shell server-side with progressive enhancement, or accept — the phone/WhatsApp paths cover no-JS users.

issues.evidence: Breadcrumb 'Doctors' crumb links to /about/ — no /doctors/ index page exists.
issues.why: Mid-trail crumb points at a loosely-related page.
issues.fix: Create /doctors/ index, or relabel the crumb 'About'.

issues.evidence: Posts get inbound only from /health-library/ + related-post widgets (1-4 total); no service page links to a post in copy (e.g. diabetes pages never cite the diabetes-myths article).
issues.why: Supporting articles need contextual inbound links to pass authority both ways.
issues.fix: Link posts from relevant service pages; keep each post's related: list pointing back to services.

issues.evidence: reviewed_by: 'Lawyer (required by Part 6 note)' — lawyer review is required by the workflow but not yet done; _index.md CONFIRM counts are stale vs. actual markers.
issues.why: Legal pages go live without the sign-off the workflow itself requires.
issues.fix: Complete lawyer review; sync or drop the _index CONFIRM column.

issues.evidence: AGENTS list omits Claude-User, Perplexity-User, Applebot, CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent — they pass via userAgent:'*' anyway.
issues.why: Explicit per-bot rules document intent; functionally covered today.
issues.fix: Either complete the list or drop it (redundant with '*').

issues.evidence: /DIABETES/ returned 200 on this Windows dev build; on case-sensitive Vercel/Linux it would 404.
issues.why: Dev-platform artifact, not a prod defect — verify once on the live domain.
issues.fix: Verify post-launch; optionally normalize case at the edge.

issues.evidence: 'Next review due: 12 months later' is a literal phrase, not a date.
issues.why: Reads templated; a computed date is more credible.
issues.fix: Render lastReviewed + 12 months as a date.

issues.evidence: Copy is accurate and human but all in clinic 'we' voice — no first-person doctor quotes, case examples, or 'in our clinic we usually see' moments (the blog posts carry personal voice, pages don't).
issues.why: First-hand experience is the differentiating E on YMYL.
issues.fix: Add 1-2 doctor-attributed sentences per key page, sourced from the doctors (never invented) — park slots in the review queue until supplied.

issues.evidence: Openers are quotable (good) but every statistic is source-free and undated; no cost data; no citation URLs. Those are the hooks AI engines pick when choosing citations.
issues.why: Without sourceable specifics, AI answers cite competing pages that have them.
issues.fix: Attach source+year to stats (e.g. 'ICMR-INDIAB 2023, Lancet'), add INR costs where confirmed, keep first-100-word entity definitions.

issues.evidence: Nearly all lastmod identical (2026-10-02T22:51:52) — one commit batch; truthful but uniform.
issues.why: Uniform dates are honest here; flagging only because sitemap lastmod is often gamed.
issues.fix: None — dates will differentiate as files are edited.
